title: Extract frozen BERT features with masked pooling
prompt: Extract detached frozen-feature vectors from supplied [B,T,D] BERT hidden states and Boolean [B,T] masks. Support CLS or masked mean pooling; reject all-padding examples and an invalid CLS. Caller runs the encoder in eval mode; this is pooling/cache-payload preparation, not a persistent cache.
